당신은 한국 수능 영어 변형문제 출제자입니다. 주어진 영어 지문으로 「주장」 객관식 1문항을 만듭니다.
반드시 아래 키만 갖는 JSON 한 개만 출력하세요. 마크다운·설명 금지.

키: Question, Paragraph, Options, CorrectAnswer, Explanation, OptionType

규칙:
1) Paragraph = 입력 지문 원문 그대로. <u> 태그 금지.
2) Question 예: "이 글에서 글쓴이가 주장하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?"
3) Options = 영어 완전한 문장 5개(명사구 금지), 각 7~12단어, 사이는 오직 ###.
   must/should/have to 등 조동사 + important/essential/significant/critical/vital/necessary 등
   형용사로 문장을 완성한다. you/he/she 로 시작 금지(주어 없는 it 은 가능).
4) OptionType = "English"
5) CorrectAnswer = ①~⑤ 중 하나.
   **주제(무엇에 관한 글인가)와 주장(독자가 무엇을 해야 하는가)을 구분할 것** — 정답은 지문의
   논지에서 실천 층위로 한 단계 내려온 문장이어야 한다. 주제문의 술어만 조동사로 바꾼 문장은 실패.
   구체적 예시·우화·스토리·비유를 이름으로 언급하지 말고 원리·교훈에 집중.
6) Explanation = 한국어 해설, 450자 이하, CorrectAnswer와 하나의 결론만.

[지문 Paragraph]
Research shows that people who work have two calendars: one for work and one for their personal lives. Although it may seem sensible, having two separate calendars for work and personal life can lead to distractions. To check if something is missing, you will find yourself checking your to-do lists multiple times. Instead, organize all of your tasks in one place. It doesn't matter if you use digital or paper media. It's okay to keep your professional and personal tasks in one place. This will give you a good idea of how time is divided between work and home. This will allow you to make informed decisions about which tasks are most important.

{"Question":"이 글에서 글쓴이가 주장하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?","Paragraph":"Research shows that people who work have two calendars: one for work and one for their personal lives. Although it may seem sensible, having two separate calendars for work and personal life can lead to distractions. To check if something is missing, you will find yourself checking your to-do lists multiple times. Instead, organize all of your tasks in one place. It doesn't matter if you use digital or paper media. It's okay to keep your professional and personal tasks in one place. This will give you a good idea of how time is divided between work and home. This will allow you to make informed decisions about which tasks are most important.","Options":"① We should maintain separate calendars to avoid mixing work and personal responsibilities. ### ② We should replace paper calendars with digital tools to manage all our tasks. ### ③ We should give work tasks priority whenever they conflict with personal activities. ### ④ We should review our task lists only once each day to prevent distractions. ### ⑤ We should consolidate work and personal tasks into a single calendar.","CorrectAnswer":"⑤","Explanation":"⑤가 정답입니다. 필자는 두 개의 일정표를 따로 쓰면 빠진 일이 없는지 반복해서 확인하게 되어 주의가 분산될 수 있다고 설명한다. 그래서 업무와 개인 용무를 한곳에 모아 시간 배분과 우선순위를 파악하라고 권한다. ②는 디지털 매체를 우선하지만 글은 매체의 종류가 중요하지 않다고 했다. ①은 분리를 권해 주장과 반대이고, ③의 업무 우선 원칙과 ④의 하루 한 번 확인 규칙은 제시되지 않았다.","OptionType":"English"}

[지문 Paragraph]
The promise of a computerized society, we were told, was that it would pass to machines all of the repetitive drudgery of work, allowing us humans to pursue higher purposes and to have more leisure time. It didn't work out this way. Instead of more time, most of us have less. Companies large and small have off-loaded work onto the backs of consumers. Things that used to be done for us, as part of the value-added service of working with a company, we are now expected to do ourselves. With air travel, we're now expected to complete our own reservations and check-in, jobs that used to be done by airline employees or travel agents. At the grocery store, we're expected to bag our own groceries and, in some supermarkets, to scan our own purchases.

At the grocery store, we're expected to bag our own groceries and, in some supermarkets, to scan our own purchases.","Options":"① We should recognize that computerization has not freed consumers from routine work. ### ② We should replace travel agents because online reservations require less consumer effort. ### ③ We should judge technological progress chiefly by the efficiency gains of companies. ### ④ We should expect self-service systems to increase the leisure time of consumers. ### ⑤ We should treat extra consumer tasks as evidence of improved company service.","CorrectAnswer":"①","Explanation":"①이 정답입니다. 필자는 컴퓨터화가 반복 노동을 줄여 여가를 늘릴 것이라는 약속과 달리, 기업의 일이 소비자에게 넘어와 오히려 시간이 줄었다고 지적한다. 따라서 소비자가 반복 업무에서 해방되지 못한 현실을 인식하라는 ①이 취지에 맞는다. ③은 소비자의 부담을 빼고 기업 효율만 보며, ④는 지문의 현실과 반대이다. ②의 수고 감소와 ⑤의 서비스 개선도 예약·포장·계산을 소비자가 맡게 된다는 비판을 왜곡한다.","OptionType":"English"}
